g.text: N0 cold-pair: complete paired trajectories within each mapping
No pooling, suffix selection, empty subtraction, or outlier removal
Every curve contains 64 signed differences. Vertical markers show four descriptive 16-trial blocks, not new qualification cells.
Panel y ranges differ and retain all tails. CNTFRQ = 19.2 MHz; no core-cycle conversion.
